title: Senior Thermal Engineer, Expeditionary AI / HPC Data Centers
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Thermal Engineering team's work is essential to support our rapid innovation cycle and maintain the performance and reliability of advanced defense technologies. Thermal Engineers own the full development life cycle from conceptual design through prototyping, lab and field testing, and operational deployment, ensuring high-performance, resilient systems that meet the demands of complex, contested environments.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Thermal Engineer in Costa Mesa, CA to own the thermal management of expeditionary AI/HPC data centers-air-transportable, modular compute and command-and-control infrastructure built to run at forward operating locations. You will apply a deep understanding of heat transfer, fluid dynamics, and HVAC to keep high-density compute running reliably in austere environments with extreme temperatures and limited power.

What You'll Do

• Own the thermal design and analysis of deployable data center cooling systems-air-side and water-side cooling, heat rejection, chilled water plant, and liquid cooling-from rack and chip level up through the full facility.

• Use first principles to discern the right level of analysis, running hand calcs, spreadsheets, and MATLAB/Python first-order models before detailed design.

• Define cooling architecture and heat-rejection strategy-CRAH/CRAC, air-side economization, chilled water plants, dry coolers, CDUs, rear-door heat exchangers, and direct-to-chip and immersion liquid cooling-to keep equipment within limits as power density scales.

• Develop cooling approaches for high-density racks and trade off air, liquid, and hybrid cooling for modular, transportable systems in austere, high-ambient environments.

• Work with electrical, mechanical, and facilities engineers to characterize IT and equipment heat loads across operating and failure modes.

• Weigh cooling architectures against reliability, efficiency (PUE/WUE), and total cost, driving trade studies that balance thermal margin with capital and operating cost.

• Own the thermal FEA/CFD and system models, predict facility performance, and set red/yellow limits for commissioning and operation.

• Lead prototype builds, field testing, commissioning, and operational validation of cooling designs (CAD, sensor and DAQ selection, data post-processing, results).

• Present thermal status at internal and customer reviews with a clear view of timelines and technical status.

• Develop internal tools to improve analysis effectiveness and efficiency.

• Support failure reviews and root-cause analysis with test data and thermal analysis.

Required Qualifications

• MS or higher in mechanical engineering, applied physics, or related field focused on heat transfer, fluid dynamics, and HVAC

• In-depth understanding of heat transfer and fluid dynamics

• 5+ years designing thermal management systems for data centers or comparable mission-critical infrastructure

• Full-spectrum data center thermal experience-air-side and water-side cooling, heat rejection, chilled water plant design, power density management, and liquid cooling

• Steady-state and transient system modeling of thermal management systems, including HVAC and refrigerant simulations

You will work closely with internal stakeholders, X++ developers, SQL/SSIS specialists, and offshore CRM integration teams to design, configure, and deliver effective Finance and Warehousing solutions on the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform. description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

THE ROLE

Clipboard Health is a marketplace that connects healthcare facilities with professionals looking for shifts.

Our largest customers operate at significant scale, and their problems don't always fit neatly into a single team or function. A product implementation might stall because of an operational workflow. A payroll issue might involve the customer, our Operations team, Product, and Engineering. An integration might technically work but fail to work for the people actually using it.

We need someone who can step into those situations and figure them out.

As a Forward Deployed Analyst, you'll work directly with some of our most important enterprise customers to solve complex operational and product problems. You'll get close to the customer, understand how their business actually works, diagnose what's going wrong, and coordinate the people needed to fix it.

You won't necessarily have direct authority over the teams doing the work. Instead, you'll create clarity, build alignment, and keep things moving.

Your job is to take a messy problem and turn it into a solved problem.

Some days that might mean analyzing data to understand why a customer's staffing workflow isn't working. Other days might involve coordinating a complex implementation across Product, Engineering, and Operations, troubleshooting a payroll or time clock issue, or working with a customer's leadership team to get a stalled initiative back on track.

The problems will change. The expectation won't: you own the outcome.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own complex customer and operational problems from diagnosis through resolution

- Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their workflows, challenges, and goals

- Build relationships with customer stakeholders ranging from frontline operators to VP and Director-level leaders

- Diagnose problems by combining customer conversations, operational context, data, and system behavior

- Break ambiguous problems into clear workstreams, priorities, owners, and timelines

- Lead complex customer implementations, particularly involving time clock compliance, payroll, and integrations with systems like ADP and UKG

- Partner closely with Product and Engineering to investigate issues, define solutions, and drive execution

- Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Operations, and customer teams to remove blockers and keep critical initiatives moving

- Manage expectations and communicate clearly when timelines, priorities, or solutions change

- Identify recurring operational and customer problems and turn those insights into improvements to our product and processes

- Build new processes or approaches when existing ones aren't sufficient to solve the problem

- Travel to customer sites occasionally when being there in person will help move an important problem or implementation forward

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 2-6 years of experience in consulting, operations, strategy and operations, implementation, customer strategy, program management, or a similar problem-solving role

- Experience working directly with customers or clients, particularly in complex or high-stakes situations

title: Contract Writer - A Book for Those Who Need Help Navigating In-Law Relationships
description:
Location: Remote
Position Overview
In-law relationships can be a source of tension that strains marriages and families. Miscommunication, unmet expectations, loyalty conflicts, and differing family cultures often create friction that feels difficult to resolve. We are seeking a contract writer to serve mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law who desire wisdom for navigating these complex family dynamics. This book should offer biblical insight and practical guidance that strengthens marriages and extended families rather than deepening division.
Scope of Work

• Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000-75,000 words)

• Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision

• Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co. ’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment
Contract, per-project basis.
Compensation
Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.
Additional Information
Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.
Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co. ?
With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books-but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.
Proposal Requirements

Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.
Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:
1. Title and Subtitle
2. Controlling Idea (1-2 sentences)
3. One-Paragraph Summary
Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.
4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

• Their stage or season of life

• The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing

• Why this book matters to them now

• Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2-3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2-3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

• How your book overlaps with each one

• How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio
Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

• Education

• Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience

• Subject-matter expertise

• Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)

• Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline
Provide a working table of contents that includes:

• Chapter titles

• The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)
Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).
9. Timeline and Specifications
Include:

• Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)

• Estimated total word count (typically 45,000-75,000 words)

• Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)
If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co. , please include a brief description of each idea (1-3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.
11. Sample Material

• The complete book introduction

• Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript

description:

(Flexible, Paid Workshops + Upside)
About CourseCareers

CourseCareers is an online education platform that helps people launch new careers without a college degree or prior experience .
We partner with industry professionals to create job-focused courses that teach practical, employer-aligned skills across technology, business, construction, and the trades. Our students are career changers looking for realistic, entry-level roles - and coaching helps bridge the gap between coursework and landing the job.

We’re looking for a part-time Construction Estimating Career Coach to support students through live workshops and optional 1:1 coaching.
This is not a traditional employment role and not a guaranteed-income position . It’s a flexible, paid opportunity best suited for construction estimating professionals who enjoy mentoring, teaching, and helping others break into the field - with upside if students choose to work with you.
How This Role Actually Works

• You host a live, one-hour workshop (seminar-style) for students

• You are paid $50 per workshop , plus any private coaching business you acquire

• You may receive exclusive coaching opportunities based on performance and engagement

• Workshops are used to provide value, answer questions, and showcase your expertise

• If students choose to book you for 1:1 coaching, you keep the coaching revenue

• You set your own availability and working hours

There is no requirement to convert students - workshops are paid regardless - but conversion is where the upside comes from.
Responsibilities

• Host a live, one-hour workshop on a monthly basis

• Answer student questions related to construction estimating and the job search

• Share real-world insight into what entry-level estimating roles actually look like

• Explain how estimating works in real construction environments (GCs, subs, specialty trades)

• Discuss common tools, workflows, and expectations

• Provide optional 1:1 coaching to students who request it

What We’re Looking For

• Experience estimating for GCs, subcontractors, or specialty trades (e.g. concrete, electrical, mechanical, roofing, etc.)

• Familiarity with estimating tools such as Excel, PlanSwift, Bluebeam, ProEst, or similar software

• Strong understanding of entry-level roles like Estimating Assistant, Junior Estimator, or Project Coordinator

• Interest in mentoring and helping career changers

• Strong communication and teaching ability

• Availability at least three evenings per week , ideally Tuesday-Thursday

• Self-starter mindset - comfortable leading workshops independently

Ideal Fit
This role is a great fit if you:

• Enjoy teaching and mentoring

• Want flexible, side income

• Like the idea of being paid to teach - with optional upside

• Don’t need guaranteed hours or full-time income

Compensation

• No caps, no quotas, no minimums

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI

U nás nebudeš jen kontrolovat tabulky. Tvým úkolem bude hlídat soulad s předpisy, komunikovat s úřady a budovat firemní kulturu, kde lidé vnímají bezpečnost jako přirozenou věc. Ve spolupráci s interními týmy i externími partnery budeš neustále vylepšovat procesy, snižovat rizika a starat se o stabilní a bezpečný provoz za každé situace.

Proč je tahle role zajímavá

- Reálný dopad: Budeš mít přímý vliv na bezpečnost stovek lidí i plynulost denního provozu našich skladů.

- Rozvoj zavedeného i nového: Zapojíš se do projektů modernizace a rozšiřování hal, kde nastavíš bezpečnostní prvky přímo od návrhu.

- Široký záběr: Spojíš EHS (BOZP/PO) s fyzickou a technickou bezpečností - od kamerových systémů po krizové řízení.

- Aktivní role v provozu: Nejde o kancelářskou teorii, ale o praktické řešení rizik přímo na místě a úzkou spolupráci s týmy napříč firmou.

Co tě u nás čeká

- Definování a prosazování standardů: Budeš mít hlavní slovo při nastavování EHS a bezpečnostních směrnic napříč našimi sklady.

- Hodnocení rizik a krizové řízení: Povedeš analýzy rizik, tvorbu krizových plánů a zajistíš stoprocentní připravenost na mimořádné situace.

- Komunikace s úřady a partnery: Staneš se klíčovým partnerem pro externí instituce, orgány veřejné správy i dodavatele.

- Podpora rozvoje skladů: Pohlídáš, aby se při návrhu a rozšiřování hal myslelo na moderní bezpečnostní systémy, CCTV a ochranné prvky.

- Spolupráce napříč Rohlíkem: S týmy provozu a HR se budeš podílet na školeních, zajištění první pomoci, vyšetřování incidentů a nastavování preventivních opatření.

- Správa technických systémů: Dohlédneš na fungování fyzické ostrahy, kamerových systémů (CCTV), EZS a přístupových systémů.

Co od tebe očekáváme

- Zkušenosti z oblasti EHS a bezpečnosti: Prokazatelnou praxi v oblasti firemní bezpečnosti, BOZP/PO nebo řízení rizik (ideálně z logistiky, FMCG nebo facility).

- Přehled v technických systémech: Znalost fungování fyzické bezpečnosti (CCTV, EZS, alarmy, přístupové systémy).

- Zkušenost s jednáním s úřady: Praxi v komunikaci s policií, hasiči nebo jinými orgány veřejné správy.

- Analytické a řešitelské myšlení: Schopnost vyhodnocovat rizika, hledat reálné příčiny problémů a navrhovat efektivní řešení.

- Jazykové vybavení: Plynulou češtinu/slovenštinu a angličtinu minimálně na úrovni B2 pro interní komunikaci.

- Odborná způsobilost nebo certifikace: Vzdělání v oboru (bezpečnost, požární ochrana), certifikace NEBOSH nebo odborná způsobilost v prevenci rizik/PO jsou velkou výhodou.

Wir begleiten Mediziner:innen durch ihre Promotion - von Methodik über Auswertung bis zur fertigen Dissertation. Unsere Klient:innen sind keine Studenten, sondern erwachsene Profis, die liefern müssen. Du bist die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das passiert.

Ehrlich gesagt
Wir sind ein kleines Unternehmen mit hoher Schlagzahl und hoher Effizienz. Wir brauchen sorgfältige, einsatzbereite und belastbare Leute, die methodisch sauber arbeiten, überdurchschnittlich verdienen wollen und in einem wachsenden Unternehmen von Anfang an dabei sein wollen.
Im Gegenzug bekommst du etwas, das ein Konzern nicht bieten kann: Vom ersten Tag an eigene Projekte, direkten Kundenkontakt, sichtbare Wirkung, und einen Aufstieg, der sich an deinen Ergebnissen bemisst und nicht an deiner Betriebszugehörigkeit.

• Mehrere parallele Projekte koordinieren - Termine, Qualität, Kundenkontakt

• KI- und Automatisierungstools so einsetzen, dass du schneller und besser wirst als ohne

• Mit Professor:innen, Lehrstühlen und Forschungsstellen sauber kommunizieren

Was du mitbringst

• Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor oder Master) in Statistik, Psychologie (empirisch/quantitativ), Sozialwissenschaft (quant), Wirtschaftsmathematik, BWL mit Empirie-Schwerpunkt, Mathematik, Public Health (quantitativ) oder vergleichbar. Eine Promotion ist nicht erforderlich und gibt hier keinen Bonus.

• Strukturierte, methodische Arbeitsweise. Du planst, bevor du loslegst. Du arbeitest sorgfältig statt hektisch. Du erkennst Inkonsistenzen in Daten oder Texten, die andere überlesen.

• Bodenständigkeit. Du hast in deinem Leben schon einmal richtig gearbeitet - Gastro, Bau, Pflege, Pflichtdienst, Lager, Versorgerjobs, körperliche Tätigkeiten neben dem Studium. Wer einmal eine 10-Stunden-Schicht in der Küche oder auf der Baustelle gemacht hat, weiß, was ehrliche Arbeit bedeutet

• Aktuelle Statistik-Praxis. Du hast in den letzten 12 Monaten konkret mit R, Python, SPSS oder MAXQDA gearbeitet - nicht nur im Studium.

About Tiko
Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.
Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behavior-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.
We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.
Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short video.
Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.
For this position, we are happily looking for candidates currently based in Portugal.

• Lead and develop the individuals in your team.

• Our team works in an agile way and you will be part of the rituals and practices.

• Ensuring that the software you develop is secure and safe when it comes to data protection.

• You document your work and make sure that your documentation is clear and understandable for future use by others.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!
Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.
This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.
Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.
This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.
What you will do

Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.

title: Clinical Oncology Specialist, GU
description:
Territory: Mid-Atlantic

Natera is seeking an experienced Clinical Oncology Specialist (COS) to join our specialized Genitourinary (GU) Oncology sales team. This high-impact, tumor-specific role will focus on driving adoption and growth of  Signatera™, Natera's personalized, tumor-informed molecular residual disease (MRD) test , across the GU Oncology landscape.

Signatera is a circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) assay designed to detect molecular residual disease and monitor disease recurrence. Across GU cancers, including bladder, renal cell carcinoma, and testicular cancers, Signatera provides highly specific molecular insights that can help clinicians assess recurrence risk, monitor disease status, and inform individualized patient management strategies.

The Clinical Oncology Specialist will serve as a strategic field partner and key representative of Natera Oncology, developing relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and healthcare providers across academic medical centers, integrated delivery networks, hospital systems, and select community oncology practices.

This position will have a primary focus on Urologic Oncology, with key call points including Urologic Oncologists, GU Surgical Oncologists, Radiation Oncologists, Medical Oncologists, Pathologists, and other healthcare providers involved in the diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing management of patients with genitourinary cancers.

• Build and strengthen relationships with Urologic Oncologists, GU Surgical Oncologists, Medical Oncologists, Radiation Oncologists, Pathologists, and other key stakeholders across the GU Oncology continuum of care.

• Drive new account acquisition, expand existing partnerships, and identify growth opportunities within academic medical centers, hospital systems, leading urology practices, and community oncology networks.

• Educate healthcare providers on Signatera's clinical applications, supporting evidence, and value in the management of GU cancers, including bladder, kidney, and testicular cancers.

• Develop relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) specializing in GU Oncology, particularly within major academic medical centers and leading urology and oncology practices.

title: Operations Assistant
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
The Operations Assistant will support the Offshore Administration team in executing compliance auditing, lease administration, and operational tasks across Bridge33’s property portfolio. This role is a key contributor to the COI (Certificate of Insurance) Audit Project and other ongoing compliance initiatives. The successful candidate will work closely with the Operations Team Lead to ensure tenant compliance with lease requirements, maintain accurate records, and deliver timely, high-quality output to internal business units.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Tenant Compliance & Lease Administration

• Conduct COI (Certificate of Insurance) audits to verify tenant compliance with lease insurance requirements

• Track and monitor critical lease delivery dates and compliance deadlines

• Review and interpret commercial lease agreements to identify tenant obligations (sales reporting, HVAC inspections, insurance, etc.)

• Maintain and update compliance tracking records across the property portfolio

• Flag and escalate non-compliant tenants to the appropriate team members

Reporting & Documentation

• Compile and distribute regular recurring compliance and performance reports

• Prepare presentation materials and summaries as directed by management and team leaders

• Maintain consistency with company-standard form documents used across the organization

• Process and accurately record received data in a timely manner

Communication & Coordination

• Serve as a responsive point of contact via Slack and Front (email platform) for internal business units including Leasing, Asset Management, Property Management, Legal, and Tenants

• Manage personal and administrative inboxes daily, ensuring timely responses and follow-through

• Communicate clearly and professionally in written and verbal English

Database & Systems Management

• Enter, update, and maintain data in property management and compliance tracking systems

• Utilize MS Office Suite, Google Suite, and other designated software platforms proficiently

• Leverage AI tools to increase work efficiency and output quality

General Operations Support

• Assist team members with tasks during high-volume periods or as needed

• Take on additional projects and assignments as directed by the Operations Team Lead

• Resolve routine operational issues independently and escalate complex matters appropriately

Requirements
QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

• 2+ years of experience in property management, commercial real estate, or leasing administration

• Working knowledge of tenant compliance requirements and commercial lease interpretation

• Familiarity with ACORD forms (e.g., ACORD 25, 27, 28) and the ability to read and interpret Certificates of Insurance and Evidence of Property Insurance

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to spot discrepancies between documents (e.g., coverage limits, dates, policy types)

• Discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential tenant, financial, and insurance information

• Strong English communication skills both written and verbal

• Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Drive)

• Experience with data entry, record keeping, and database management

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines consistently

• High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

Preferred

• Direct experience with COI audits or insurance compliance tracking

• Familiarity with commercial lease documents and lease administration systems
